profile.headline: Full-stack Developer at USAA
profile.summary:
Hello.
Currently working for USAA as a Full Stack developer. 
My job description includes developing and maintaining React based websites, Java Spring based APIs, unit tests, automated functional tests, analyzing code for security vulnerabilities, refactoring code for readability, and migrating to open source technologies. 

My professional interests include machine learning, cloud infrastructures, and object-oriented programming. 
Some of my hobbies are ping pong, video games, weight-exercising, and cooking.

positions.title: Java Software Engineer
positions.description:
Java development -  Rewiring service call APIs into Java.
DevOps - Continuous integration and delivery using Jenkins & Ansible. 
Security - Resolution of open vulnerabilities found by Fortify, RASP, and BlackDuck.
Open source migration - Seamless migration to Tomcat based servers, and Cassandra based database. 
Data visualization through elasticsearch.
Build release maintenance using Artifactory.

positions.title: Gear Up Outreach Mentor
positions.description:
Tutored students in undergrad Computer Science courses.
Mentored in introductory java, discrete mathematics, programming languages, financial aid, degree paths, and general academic advise. 
Worked with a set of 30 students for almost two years.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Developed Python & MATLAB programs to manipulate 16-wavelength multispectral camera data into images.
Resolved images by using de-noising filters (gaussian smoothing, neighborhood filters, unsharp masking, quotient image normalization), image warping using homography, histogram equalization, magnitude of gradience)
Used k-means clustering, machine learning for image classification.
Created a final project program to detect faces from a video using HAAR descriptors, then warp spots of the face to imitate popular Snapchat filters.

company.name: The University of Texas at El Paso

positions.title: Project Analyst, ARL Testbed Management System
positions.description:
Worked closely in a team of 5 to develop a testbed management system for ARL, the client. 
Drafted a software contract and interview report for client, continued design alterations through memorandums.
Software design documents built: Class-Responsibility-Collaborator, Software Configuration Management, Dataflow Diagram, Use Case Diagram, Statechart Diagram, Class Diagram, Traceability Report, Feasibility Report, and a full implementation Prototype compiled from a Software Requirements Specification report.

company.name: U.S. Army CCDC Army Research Laboratory

positions.description: Full time summer, part time rest. Provide customer service, take orders, maintain a clean workplace, pickup merchandise, make deliveries. Manage social and advertising networks.
